design_intent: A bridge-aligned, human-scale signal portal whose three unequal bronze bells are readable from both rope-span approaches without narrowing the deck.
_signal_note: P2-053: the pier signals were saturated cyan orbs at emission 2.4 that out-shone the bells and stone; they now use the realm's warm lamp colour (as the Flight Aerie signals) at a lamp-level glow.
